description: Text to speech. Synchronous: returns the finished audio URL and the exact charge. Billed in started blocks of 1,000 characters (about 9c a block at typical prices, see corent.tech/pricing), so a short line costs the same as a paragraph. Corent picks the model; a model the user names in the text is used. Call list_voices first to pick a voice_id.

language.description: ISO code for the multilingual models, e.g. "en" or "pt-BR".

max_cost_cents.description: The most this may cost, in cents. Set it when the user gives a budget or a price limit. Refused before anything is spent when no model fits under it, and never exceeded.

model.description: Pin an exact speech model by name, e.g. "corent-eleven-multilingual-v2" (list_models shows the menu with kind="speech"; every name there is spelled corent-*). Only for a user who insists on one exact model.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model. Has no effect when `model` pins one.

similarity.description: 0 to 1. How closely to hold the voice's character.

stability.description: 0 to 1. Low is more expressive and varies more take to take; high is steadier.

text.description: The text to speak, max 5000 characters. If the user names a voice model ("using eleven v3, read this: hello"), leave it in: Corent uses that model when it can and does not read those words aloud.

voice_id.description: Optional provider voice id; omit for the default narration voice

name: generate_speech
title: Generate speech (voice)
